_note_zone_loads: ADR 0111 amendment 4 (ui-menus, at the Lead's request after the PC's pass 3): a transition also stages the zone's runtime materials and scenes (the ones game/data/ui/scene_loads.json lists, as ResidentLoads loads them), up to zone_loads_per_frame a frame (the batch still halves on a frame over slice_budget_ms), and the swap waits while it stages (SceneRouter: a loading holder's progress). A zone's dressing, villagers and wildlife build at runtime, so the scene scan never saw them; their pipelines compiled in the zone's first frames.
_note_compute_twin: M1-RND-27: an entry with "compute_twin" true (the Undertow body shaders) is not drawn when the preset's storm tier marches the body in compute (ShaderPrewarm.undertow_uses_compute: a RenderingDevice and a body_scale under 1); its compute twin's pipeline is created instead (UndertowBodyEffect.warm_pipeline). Ultra (full-resolution body) still draws it.
_note_resident_presets: An entry with "resident" true is held from the boot warm-up on every preset, or only on those its optional "resident_presets" lists (ShaderPrewarm.entry_resident). Asha's materials are resident on all four: holding them takes Haluna's entry from 2.9-3.6 s to 2.1-2.8 s (Low streaming was 3.5-3.6 s, over ADR 0029's 3 s) for ~245 MB of texture memory from the title on (Low: 285 MB against 39). Drop a preset from the list to stream her materials on it.
_note_first_run: M1-RND-29: the boot run on a launch with no first_run_marker for this engine, GPU, driver and preset (ShaderPrewarm.needs_first_run) stages every entry the preset wants and harvests first_run_scenes, behind the boot card, then writes the marker. A fresh install then builds its pipelines once, at boot.
_note_preset_tier: M1-RND-22: an entry with "preset_tier" {system, tier} is staged only when the active preset selects that tier (system character: CharacterShaderTiers.tier_for_preset; undertow: the preset id; else the preset's "tiers" in graphics_presets.json). Untagged entries are staged on every preset. A preset change runs its own prewarm for the new tier.

_note_first_run_live: M2-RND-15: a first run also instances these scenes on a worker thread (a zone prebuilds itself off the tree), stages a draw of every mesh, MultiMesh and material the live instance holds (at most max_live_materials), and frees it. They cover the surfaces a zone builds at runtime, which no SceneState lists; on an empty driver cache Haluna's first frame compiled 92 surface pipelines at once (1.6-1.7 s). M2-RND-17: the Shell Shrine too (its hall is built at runtime; effective once ShellShrineLevel builds it on instantiate, M2-ENV-12): its cold first frame 1.9 s -> 0.19 s.
_note_first_run_batch: M2-RND-18: a first run's batch size. On an empty driver cache one material compiles all its passes in one frame (up to ~1.3 s); two to a batch made the boot's worst hidden frame 1.7 s (Low) and 3.0 s (High).
